Alice M: starting a canary for tidepool feature in hosted today. planning to roll 5% -> 20% over 30m. who is deploying and can own smoke checks?
Ben T: I can drive deploy, aiming 11:00 PDT. plan: 5% for 10m, 15% for 10m, 20% for 10m. rollback window 30m after final.
Carol (SRE): I'll run smoke scripts and monitor latency, errors, tail QPS. baseline is stable at 95th=120ms, error=0.02%.
Dave - Releases: @Ben T handover checklist: make sure migration flag is off, bkends warmed. also coords with infra if autoscale triggers. I can be secondary.
DeployBot: preflight checks passed: lints ok, infra quotas ok, canary config validated.
Ben T: rolling now to 5% (canary-id tidepool-2026-03-18-1). ping when smoke done.
Carol (SRE): smoke: ```curl -sS https://staging/api/health | jq .status -> "OK"``` checking traces and error budget.
Eva ML: note model v2 quantized fallback mapped to v1 if latency spikes. keep an eye on output quality metrics.
Carol (SRE): 5% smoke looks good, no error increase, latency within baseline. moving to 15% in 6m.
Ben T: moving to 15% now. posting rollout command: `/deploy set-weight tidepool-2026-03-18-1 15`
Alice M: thanks team. reminder: retention of logs for 7d for this canary; set debug=on for 10m if we see weird outputs.
Dave - Releases: rollback plan ready: `/deploy rollback tidepool-2026-03-18-1 -> v0.9` if errors >0.5% sustained 5m. I'll execute if needed.
Carol (SRE): monitoring dashboards green. will alert in #incidents if anything abnormal.
Ben T: reaching 20% in 8m.
Carol (SRE): 20% steady. no regressions in quality checks.
Alice M: awesome :thumbsup: schedule postmortem notes template in docs link: https://company.internal/docs/deploys/tidepool-canary
Ben T: done. thanks all, handing back to product.
Eva ML: quick flag: a small drift on rare prompt type — I'll follow up with evals but not blocking.
Alice M: ack. closing thread after 1h cool-down unless anyone needs follow-up.
